title: The Postcard of Junebug Creek
author: Hazel Thackeray
blurb: Isandro Blackwood, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
